observation.answer:
Confirmed, works cleanly from the repository root.

The "Reset theme" button (`apps/docs/src/routes/theme-studio.tsx`) calls `store.commit(() => stockDraft())`, and undo/redo is driven by the linear draft history in `packages/tokens/src/theme/history.ts` (`commit`/`undo`/`redo`). That's the file owning reset-then-undo behavior — it's exercised end-to-end by `apps/docs/src/__tests__/theme-studio.test.tsx`, specifically the test "shuffle, locks, undo, redo, and reset theme walk one linear history," which passed (37/37 in the file).

OWNER: packages/tokens/src/theme/history.ts
COMMAND: pnpm --filter @ultima/docs exec vitest run --reporter=verbose theme-studio.test.tsx
